aliases_note: Present to the page with no file publishing the name in DirectWrite: Blink's AlternateFamilyName maps Courier to Courier New, Helvetica to Arial and Times to Times New Roman (HKLM FontSubstitutes also lists Helvetica=Arial). COURE.FON and COURF.FON are GDI bitmap fonts, which Chrome's DirectWrite path does not load, so they are not imported.

captured.family_names: fonts.families is every name that resolves as a CSS family in stock Chrome 156 on the machine
captured.machine: a CHUWI laptop (Celeron J4125, Intel UHD Graphics 600), the capture host of profile win11-uhd600-1440x960
captured.selection: every font file on the machine (530; not StaticCache.dat, desktop.ini, fms_metadata.xml, which are DirectWrite cache and folder metadata). families maps each fonts.families name to the files with a face of that name (legacy, typographic, WWS, full, PostScript, localized, a variable font named instance's WWS or GDI family, or the name with DirectWrite's style words dropped), else to the files of the name left after dropping its trailing style words (Blink's weight-suffix retry on Windows)
captured.tool: fontTools 4.60.1 over the imported copies; hashes checked against Get-FileHash on the machine

office-16-leftover.note: Files created in C:\Windows\Fonts on 2026-09-10 by an Office 16 Click-to-Run install that was removed the same day (MsiInstaller events); the fonts stayed. SegoeIcons.ttf and seguiemj.ttf were rewritten that day by Windows, not Office. A page on this machine sees them, so the profile lists every family of it; a Windows profile without Office would drop this unit.

windows.note: Fonts that ship with Windows 11 25H2 on this machine.
